evidence_quotes: De vergunning voor de uitbreiding en verandering van een biogasinstallatie in Luttelgeest houdt stand.
Er is voldoende duidelijkheid over wat er met het afvalwater gebeurt.
rationale: The decision concerns a general environmental permit, EIA screening, Natura-2000 assessment, air emissions, and odour nuisance for the expansion of a biogas production plant in Luttelgeest. Although one brief sentence notes that there is sufficient clarity regarding what happens with wastewater ('afvalwater'), this mention is purely incidental to a broader industrial/energy environmental permit dispute rather than substantive water law, water governance, or wastewater infrastructure adjudication.
